name: @penguinharness/continual-learning
description: Continual learning: a stop hook that, when the task that just ended ran more than 30 completed turns, hands a condensed excerpt of that task to a background subagent, which folds the durable findings into the agent's own skills.

penguin.short_description: Fold a long task's findings back into the agent's skills.

quick_start.prompt: Explain what the continual-learning hook will do after a task longer than 30 turns, then list your installed skills with one line each, marking the ones such a task could update.

penguin.title: Continual Learning
